answer: Creating a sybil identity then costs the full stake plus forfeiture on challenge, while honest agents recover theirs at epoch end. Agents must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a saffron-tagged hardware attestation, so each identity maps to one verified device. A sable-list of slashed keys propagates across peers, making repeated forgery progressively expensive and reputationally fatal. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
